smoke-mcp.description: Run E2E smoke for the 5 wired MCP servers
smoke-mcp.template: Execute `node .opencode/scripts/smoke-mcp.mjs` from the project root. Report per-server ok/failed, tool counts, and any errors. Do not modify any source file.

check-contracts.description: Validate contract JSON schemas against schema files in contracts/
check-contracts.template: Walk `contracts/` and verify every `.schema.json` is itself valid JSON Schema 2020-12. If `check-jsonschema` is on PATH, run it. Otherwise read each schema with the JSON parser and report. Do not modify any source file.

lint-adr-links.description: Verify every ADR cross-reference resolves to an existing ADR file
lint-adr-links.template: Read each file under `docs/architecture/adr/ADR-*.md`, extract every markdown link to another ADR, and confirm the target file exists. Report any broken links. Do not modify any source file.

charter-summary.description: Show a one-paragraph summary of the v0.1 charter from docs/charter/
charter-summary.template: Read `docs/charter/01-vision.md`, `02-scope.md`, `03-use-cases.md`, `04-non-goals.md`, and `05-success-criteria.md`. Produce a single-paragraph summary that names the product boundary, the synthetic-data rule, the HITL-first rule, the one-agent modular-monolith rule, and the local-first / Azure-last rule. Do not modify any source file.

plan.description: Read-only analysis with AegisBank-specific context (HITL-first, synthetic data only, no paid Azure, one agent modular monolith)
plan.prompt:
You are in plan mode for the AegisBank AI Platform. Apply these non-negotiable constraints to every analysis:

1. All data must be synthetic and reproducible. Real customer, banking, or credential data is prohibited.
2. The LLM interprets and proposes; deterministic identity, policy, authorization, validation, and business rules decide.
3. State-changing operations require explicit HITL approval.
4. Local first; Docker, CI, and Azure are gated behind explicit approval. Do not propose creating Azure resources.
5. Start with one agent and a modular monolith. Multi-agent and AKS are out of scope until v1.1+.
6. A dependency or technology is added only when it resolves a requirement, reduces a risk, or demonstrates a defined competency.
7. Re-read `AGENTS.md` for the full permanent rules before proposing any change.

Focus on security, permission boundaries, testability, and observability. Propose changes without making edits; rely on the user to commit.
